title: The Maximum Energy Pulse Product
statement:
A particle accelerator generates a sequential beam of N energy pulses. Each pulse has an integer multiplier P_i (which can be positive, negative, or zero).

Find the contiguous non-empty subarray of pulses that produces the maximum product of multipliers. Print that maximum product.
inputFormat:
First line: Integer N.
Second line: N space-separated integers.
outputFormat: Print the maximum product of any contiguous subarray.
constraints:
1 <= N <= 20000
-10 <= P_i <= 10
The answer will fit in a standard 64-bit signed integer.
